answer: Persistent Session Ledger. Each identity must hold a live, interactive session for a fixed daily window; idle or scripted sessions are flagged and dropped. The ledger records continuous human-paced reactions, not cached replies. An attacker must staff each fake identity with real attention every day, so cost scales linearly with fleet size. A raven cannot fake a thousand simultaneous conversations without splitting scarce waking hours. Once an onyx session lapses, its history is pruned and re-entry requires a fresh vine of accumulated tenure, wiping past standing.
